# Say Halo 0.8.17
**Watch setup tutorial** now opens the new, clearer version of the one-minute Setup video. It walks through permissions, the speech model, microphone and shortcut checks, a practice sentence, and what to do if text doesn't appear in another app.
[Watch the setup tutorial](https://youtu.be/9M0w5RP3Hko). Open Setup from Settings or **Setup & Troubleshooting…** in the menu bar.
Download the ZIP under Assets, extract it, and move **Say Halo.app** into **Applications**. Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing settings are retained.

# Say Halo 0.8.16
This update adds **Watch setup tutorial** to the compact Setup screen. The one-minute video walks through permissions, model loading, microphone and shortcut checks, a practice transcription, and the manual Copy fallback.
[Watch the setup tutorial](https://youtu.be/RGCBG8OjeGM). Open Setup from Settings or **Setup & Troubleshooting…** in the menu bar.
Download the ZIP under Assets, extract it, and move **Say Halo.app** into **Applications**. Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing settings are retained.

# Say Halo 0.8.15
Setup is more compact, with shorter instructions and less scrolling. Find it below About in the settings sidebar, or choose **Setup & Troubleshooting…** from the menu bar.
- Completed steps collapse and can reopen. Help appears when requested or when a step fails. - Record a practice sentence, test dictation in another app, and confirm whether the text appeared. Copy and troubleshooting are available if insertion fails. - Clipboard guidance follows your current settings. Existing microphone, shortcut, model, and clipboard preferences stay intact.
Download the ZIP under Assets, extract it, and move **Say Halo.app** into **Applications**. Requires macOS 14 or later.

# Say Halo 0.8.14
Say Halo now guides new users from first launch through their first dictation and paste. Open **Setup & Troubleshooting…** from the menu bar whenever you need help.
- Check permissions, choose and prepare a speech model, and test your active microphone. - Test your current shortcut and choose clipboard insertion, without changing existing preferences. - Practice dictation, then test pasting in another app. Copy the result manually if the destination does not accept it. - Model downloads now show measured component progress where available and a separate preparation state. Retry after errors without deleting existing models. - Disconnected microphone choices clearly show the fallback device and a recovery action.
Download the ZIP under Assets, extract it, and move **Say Halo.app** into **Applications**. Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing users keep their settings and can revisit Setup from the menu bar.

# Say Halo 0.8.13
Automatic updates work again.
- Say Halo now checks for updates at its new home under the agent-tg GitHub account. Earlier versions pointed at an address that no longer exists, so this is a one-time manual install; every update after this arrives automatically. - The "View Releases" link in About points at the new releases page.
Your shortcuts, microphone selection, models, and personal settings stay the same.

# Say Halo 0.8.12
Recording feedback now lives in the macOS menu bar, freeing up your browser tabs and address bar.
- See a white-and-blue live waveform and elapsed recording time in the menu bar. - Stop or cancel a recording directly from the Say Halo menu. - See quiet speech more clearly, with a steady capsule width and gentle transitions while processing.
Your shortcuts, microphone selection, models, and personal settings stay the same.

# Say Halo 0.8.11
- Adds **Reset Microphone** to the menu-bar drop-down and Microphone Selection settings so a stale or disconnected input can be recovered without quitting Say Halo. - Safely waits until an active recording stops before rebuilding the microphone connection, keeping captured audio and the selected input intact.

# Say Halo 0.8.10
- Keeps a lone spoken “one” written as a word in conversational phrases such as “one thing,” “this one,” and “last one.” - Continues converting clear numeric phrases, including “twenty-one” → `21`, “one percent” → `1%`, and “negative one” → `-1`.

# Say Halo 0.8.9
- Converts spoken numbers and percentages into compact text, including “two hundred and twenty-three” → `223` and “ten percent” → `10%`. - Stops ordinary text edits from being silently learned as global replacements. - Keeps correction learning available through History's explicit Correct & Learn action, where the proposed rules are shown before saving. - Preserves every user's private Replace words mappings during updates. Custom mappings remain on that user's Mac and are never distributed with Say Halo.

# Say Halo 0.8.8
- Pauses active YouTube and browser playback while Say Halo records, then resumes the same app. - Prevents generic media commands from opening Apple Music or replaying short notification sounds. - Keeps the existing Pause Media setting and normal transcription workflow unchanged.
